(how idle interacts with passive content) has structure that a flat
The clock is a first-class input, not decoration. Bed + anime at 23:30 is
recovery; the identical camera frame and the identical window title at
14:00 is drift. Nothing but the hour separates them.
_trust_phone_note: OFF because the phone IS the camera -- this rig streams from Iriun, so
the phone is mounted and can never appear in frame. Phone-in-hand is
The detector can still fire, though: on someone else's phone, on a dark
rectangular object, on a wallet. Since the rule was written to OVERRIDE
everything on screen, leaving it on means a rule with no upside and real
downside. Off, `phone` is still recorded as a fact for analysis -- it
just no longer decides the mode.
Flip to true if a dedicated webcam ever replaces the phone, which frees
the phone to be a tracked object again.
_min_run_note: A mode must hold for this long before it is committed to the log.
Without it, glancing at Discord for eight seconds carves a real work
block into three rows and the daily rollup reports fragmented focus that
never happened. Raise it if the log looks choppy; lower it if short
